name: Goudouji Chiyo
source:
Speciality: Palm Reading, Fortune Telling, Book of Changes
Hobby: Creating Doujinshi
Likes: Supernatural Phenomenons
Dislikes: Lectures

A fortune teller who set up a stall with a lantern on the street. She manages to gather customers by being overbearing; calling out to them to stop so she can tell their fortune. In addition to divining peoples' fate and things like ESP and psychic phenomena, she's engrossed with a strong interest in the occult.

[i]"…You, over there. I can see an ominous shadow looming over your back... Leave where your fate leads to me, Himiko Houougahara!"[i]
